text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back after a day out with El Condor Pasa…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hey, this is kinda random, but do you know much about flowers?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Like, flower names and what they mean?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well… I broke one of Grass's flower vases the other day…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, it wasn't on purpose or anything!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I was just practicin' some wrestling moves in our room and I accidentally kicked it.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I apologized right away, of course, and she pretty much forgave me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But it was super important to her, so I feel really bad about it…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I wanna get her a vase and some flowers as a proper apology.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Really?! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's go first thing tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Thanks a ton, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stop by the library afterward to look into flower meanings before heading back to my place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, we go to the flower shop first thing in the morning.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass knows a ton about flowers, so we gotta pick something hella good!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I know a little bit about flowers, but when it comes to giving them to someone…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Do you know what flower would be best to give Grass in this situation?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Do you know what flower would be best to give Grass in this situation?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, they make tea out of chamomile, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain to El Condor Pasa that flowers have different meanings depending on the region, but chamomiles often mean "reconciliation."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I further explain that they can also mean "strength" and "fortitude."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I see… Then let's go with a vase and some tea!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fortitude… That's just like Grass! Perfect for my rival!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But, hmmm… Do you think it might come off as a challenge?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa laughs mischievously as we buy some chamomile leaves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When we give them to Grass Wonder later, she accepts them with a smile and warns El Condor Pasa not to let her guard down.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Those ones are small and cute, right? Just like Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So, what do they mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I read that baby's breath means "appreciation."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like a perfect fit for Grass Wonder, who has been a very helpful roommate to El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I see… That sounds perfect! I'm hella grateful for Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Baby's breath it is! Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa gives Grass Wonder pink and white baby's breath later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, Grass Wonder laughed and mentioned that the meaning of flowers changes depending on the color.
